ownership.representation: immutable host-owned tagged native snapshot; no native addresses or layout in DAS
ownership.capture: copy exact supported native event type; detach before original callback returns
ownership.detach_strategy: native type-preserving derived copy clears its own protected EventPath, then UE CopyScriptStruct stores the native value; original remains unchanged
ownership.pressed_buttons: native TSet<FKey> deep value copy, not a borrowed view
ownership.copy: copy/clone and base projections retain detached ownership; no pointers into caller stack
ownership.storage: DAS local/global/array handles share an immutable owned value in the existing per-context rooted snapshot table; callback/path/widget may expire, context must remain alive
ownership.reflection_storage: ue_property, defaults and JSON serialization deferred until separately implemented
ownership.identity: exact UScriptStruct paths and payload kind; no structural lookalikes, pointer or integer constructors
ownership.default: invalid snapshot; native dispatch must reject uninitialized or wrong-kind input

common: modifier state including left/right and caps lock
character: native TCHAR code unit (not assumed to be a full Unicode scalar)

validation.capture: game thread, outside frozen physics; trusted native capture or validated call-frame result
validation.finite: reject nonfinite analog, positions, cursor/gesture/wheel deltas and touch force; do not silently clamp
validation.precision: capture/storage/reconstruction preserve uint32 indices and uint64 timestamp; existing reflected legacy getters keep their declared int32 result semantics
validation.bounds: maximum 256 pressed keys per snapshot; reject overflow before allocation and publication
validation.transaction: validate and stage result before publishing; no partial snapshot/call outputs on failure
validation.native_calls: exact function allowlist + kind/direction checks + existing execution-role/context guards

navigation.reason: live Slate navigation config; analog query mutates per-user repeat timing
navigation.next_contract: Implemented separately by InputNavigation.contract.json; still forbidden as ordinary detached snapshot dispatch
navigation.frozen_or_expired: reject before native dispatch; no manual debug flag authorization

ui_callbacks.reply: UserWidget reply-returning overrides need a synchronous bridge; observing a detached event may be queued but cannot decide original event routing later
ui_callbacks.lifecycle: live capability invalid at callback exit/error/reload/destroy; owned detached data remains readable
ui_callbacks.missing_reply: when future bridge is implemented, failure/missing handler returns native Unhandled, never an old reply

forbidden: replay event injection from stored snapshot

projections.semantics: explicit native-compatible value slicing, detached output, no implicit downcast

separate_contracts.geometry: owned native transform value, finite/invertibility checks and stale layout semantics; separate from events
separate_contracts.event_reply: routing commands with weak widget targets, same synchronous callback epoch; cannot serialize or reuse across events
separate_contracts.paint_context: borrows draw list, geometry/style and layer state; scope-only paint capability, not a value snapshot
separate_contracts.widget_animation_handle: weak animation state, may expire even when handle IsValid; owner/revision-aware adapter required

note: Implemented owned data transport and exact ordinary function allowlist; this file documents the implementation and deferred contracts, it is not runtime configuration.
native_observer: FDasRuntimeModule.DispatchInputEventSnapshots: detached trusted native values only, UEStructValue inputs and int observer result; not Slate replay or UserWidget override
safety_requirements: native copy detaches EventPath without modifying source
all six kinds retain original metadata and owned pressed keys
destroy original path/widget, then read clone/array/base projection under GC
wrong kind/default/foreign context fail before dispatch
nonfinite data and excessive pressed keys reject atomically
navigation queries remain blocked outside live contract
generated input/out/return directions, conversion functions and result ownership
ordinary detached functions agree with native getters
reload/Destroy invalidates live capabilities but not already detached data
